Definition: Righteousness and justice — rightness measured by God's character, expressed in fair dealing, integrity and setting things right.
BiblicalUsage: Tsedeq and its family of words describe God's reign founded on righteousness and justice. The prophets longed for justice to 'roll down like waters' in a land that had abandoned God's standard.
TheologicalSignificance: Tsedeq assures a hurting world that God sees injustice and will set things right. In Christ, God's righteousness is both revealed and gifted to all who believe.
